newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans stuck in Christmas holiday autobahn jams.
newsitem.headline: Germans stuck in Christmas holiday autobahn jams.

text.p: Thousands of Germans began their Christmas holidays on Saturday in traditional style -- stranded in massive traffic jams up to 70 km (40 miles) long.
Police reported huge traffic jams and slow-moving queues on motorways in many areas, especially the southern states of Bavaria and Baden-Wuerttemberg.
Police said there were numerous traffic jams in the south, on motorways near Munich, Frankfurt and Nuremberg.
They also said traffic was backed up 70 km from the German-Polish border to Berlin.
